summary: Tested FELCONT deck backend + frontend end-to-end. All 13 backend pytest cases passed (deck/info, 9x deck/slide/{n}, 404 case, /deck/download pptx with correct MIME + Content-Disposition, /deck/pdf). Frontend loads at the public URL: deck-page, top-nav, brand-logo, hero-title 'Demonstração do Resultado do Exercício', client 'Ronaldo Donadon' all visible. The old 'Building something incredible' screen is gone. Download buttons have correct hrefs (/api/deck/download and /api/deck/pdf). Gallery renders 9 thumbnails (slide-thumb-1..9). Lightbox opens on thumb click, next/prev arrows navigate correctly (slide 3 -> 4 -> 3), and close button dismisses it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes unused Status/Mongo boilerplate with the deck feature — could be cleaned up, but not blocking.
Consider adding Cache-Control headers on /api/deck/slide/{n} for better thumbnail load performance.
The pptx href does not force download attribute; browsers may open inline. Content-Disposition attachment is already set server-side so it's fine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints all under /api/deck/*. Static assets in /app/backend/assets/deck/. Frontend has data-testids: deck-page, top-nav, brand-logo, hero-title, download-pptx-btn, download-pdf-btn, open-cover, slide-gallery, slide-thumb-1..9, lightbox, lightbox-image, lightbox-prev, lightbox-next, lightbox-close.
rca of the issue: Original bug: root URL showed default Emergent 'Building something incredible' screen because no web app existed. Fix (already applied): custom React deck page fetches /api/deck/info on mount and renders hero + 9-slide gallery + lightbox; FastAPI serves pptx/pdf/png assets under /api/deck/*. Verified fix works — root URL now loads FELCONT deck page.
